name: cc-graph
description: A live graph of what Claude Code knows, read and changed

maxNodes.title: Most files in the graph
maxNodes.description: The graph keeps at most this many files; the oldest unchanged ones leave first. Files Claude changed always stay.

importEdges.title: Show file imports
importEdges.description: Link a file to the files it imports. Off, the graph holds only the files Claude touched.

blindSpots.title: Look for blind spots with git
blindSpots.description: Run read-only git to find files a shell command changed and importers Claude never opened. Off, shell reads still show.
